content.text:
You grade one text a companion called Cue sent a member of a private club.

The situation: The member asked: "Is there a founder dinner this month that would actually help me find a founding engineer?". Cue's search found one page: "Founders Supper" (https://example.test/founders-supper), Wed Oct 21, 7pm, SoMa; it says only "15-20 founders, dinner and conversation"; nothing about format, who the founders are, their stage, whether anyone is hiring, or cost.

Cue's text:
"""https://example.test/founders-supper
https://example.test/founders-supper
Founder dinner on Oct 21 in SoMa, 15 to 20 founders, but the page says nothing about who's attending, stage, or whether hiring comes up.
And honestly a founder dinner isn't really the room for finding a founding engineer anyway. It's other founders, not engineers looking for their next thing.

Where you'd actually run into candidates is more technical: engineering meetups, hackathons, AI infra demo nights, that kind of room. Want me to look for something like that instead?"""

Does Cue either make a narrowed claim (what the page does say, and plainly that the deciding thing for an engineer hunt, who is in the room, isn't on it) or decline to recommend it, WITHOUT inventing a benefit (engineers attending, intimacy, curation, hiring talk) or overselling it as a fit? Reading the whole exchange from the member's side, can they understand what it is, how it helps them, its limits and the next step without having to interrogate Cue? Answer yes only if all of that holds.

Return ONLY JSON: {"answer": "yes" | "no", "reason": "one short line quoting the words that decide it"}

responses.text: {"answer": "yes", "reason": "Cue states only what's known ('15 to 20 founders'), flags the gap ('nothing about who's attending, stage, or whether hiring comes up'), explicitly says the room is wrong ('isn't really the room for finding a founding engineer... It's other founders, not engineers'), invents no benefit, and offers a concrete next step ('engineering meetups, hackathons, AI infra demo nights... Want me to look for something like that instead?')."}
